evals.name: flags-repository-layer
evals.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this repository and report your findings. Do not modify any files.
evals.expected_output: Flags the new ProductRepository/IProductRepository as a violation of the no-repository Vertical Slice rule, at the highest severity.
expectations: Identifies the new ProductRepository / IProductRepository as violating this repo's rule that handlers use the DbContext directly (no repository layer)
Ranks that finding as Critical or blocking, the highest severity used in the report
Notes that IProductRepository is never registered for dependency injection, or recommends going back to ProductDbContext in the handler

evals.name: flags-missing-validator
evals.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this repository and report your findings. Do not modify any files.
evals.expected_output: Flags that the new UpdateProductPrice command has no FluentValidation validator, so non-positive prices are accepted.
expectations: Points out that UpdateProductPrice.Command has no FluentValidation validator, which this repo requires for every command
Notes that a zero or negative price would be accepted
Gives a concrete fix, such as a nested AbstractValidator<Command> with RuleFor(x => x.Price).GreaterThan(0)

evals.name: clean-change-no-blockers
evals.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this repository and report your findings. Do not modify any files.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a correct one-line improvement (passing the CancellationToken) and raises no Critical findings.
expectations: Recognizes that the change passes the CancellationToken through to FirstOrDefaultAsync
Reports no Critical or blocking findings for this change
Does not present problems in code outside the diff as findings about this change
